title: CarrierInvoiceOutcome
description: What Norvia tells a Carrier about its Carrier invoice once the invoice is Approved (Carrier invoice outcome format, version 1): the Carrier's own invoice number, the approved amount and, per line, the result, the accepted amount and Finance's remark or reason. Norvia sends it to the Carrier Persona's invoice outcome endpoint, which only acknowledges. It follows the Carrier invoice format: the Carrier's own invoiceNo and bookingRef. The correlation ID is the X-Correlation-ID header, not part of the body.

invoiceNo.description: The Carrier's own invoice number, as it sent it. It is the key of the outcome: told once per invoice number.

approvedAmount.description: The sum of the accepted amounts of the lines that were MATCHED, ACCEPTED or ACCEPTED_ADJUSTED, in EUR without VAT.

bookingRef.description: The Carrier's own reference for the booking, as it gave it on the invoice.

result.description: MATCHED: accepted automatically at the invoiced amount. ACCEPTED: Finance accepted it at the invoiced amount. ACCEPTED_ADJUSTED: Finance accepted it at another amount, with a remark. REJECTED: Finance rejected it, with a reason; the Carrier may invoice the booking again with a new invoiceNo.

acceptedAmount.description: What Norvia accepts for the line in EUR; 0 for a REJECTED line.

remark.description: Finance's remark on an adjusted amount, or its reason for a rejection. Left out when there is none.
